data.narrative:
Genesis AI is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $105M to date. The valuation universe comprises ten peers in Robotics & Manufacturing, including one public company (277810.KQ) and nine private firms such as Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

Stage-progression analysis is the applicable valuation method for Genesis AI given the constraint on comparable data. Using total capital raised ($105M) as a proxy for current value and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage transitions yields an implied valuation of $262M. This method reflects expected value creation between rounds but does not incorporate sector-specific revenue multiples or growth trajectories.

Peer-median analysis could not be reliably applied. Although the Robotics & Manufacturing sector contains ten peers, the narrow peer set satisfying same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier filters did not yield three or more datapoints. An all-sector median would introduce uncontrolled variance.

The triangulated valuation range is $223M (low), $262M (median), and $302M (high), derived from sensitivity around the stage-progression result. Material uncertainties remain: the absence of narrowly comparable Seed-stage robotics companies limits validation of the 2.5x multiplier, and the analysis does not incorporate Genesis AI's specific revenue, capital efficiency, or technology defensibility relative to the broader peer set.
